verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
MU buyinike-obungi
Bwe tuba tufiiriddwa,
Bannaffe be twagala,
Otusanyuse Yesu.

verse.name: v2
v3
verse.lines:
Bwe tweraliikirira
Ne tuggwaamu amaanyi,
Byonna nga kizikiza,
Otusaasire Yesu

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Oluusi bwe tukuvuma
Era nga twerabidde,
Okwagala kwo-okungi,
Otusonyiwe Yesu.

verse.name: v5
verse.lines:
Ka tuyimuse-emyoyo
Era nga twolesebwa
Ekitiibwa mu ggulu,
Naffe tulituukayo.
